language.title: Language
language.sub: Choose the language for this app on this device.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.sub: Get alerts on this phone — even when the app is closed.
notifications.statusOn: On — this phone will get push alerts.
notifications.statusOff: Not on yet for this phone.
notifications.statusNativePending: Not on yet — coming in an app update.
notifications.statusNativeManaged: Handled by the app on this phone.
notifications.statusNativeBlocked: On here, but blocked in iPhone Settings.
notifications.statusNativeChecking: On here — checking iPhone notification access.
notifications.nativePendingHint: Push alerts aren’t switched on in the app yet. You’ll still see alerts while the app is open, and there’s nothing to set up here.
notifications.nativeManagedHint: Push is on for this app installation. Turn it off here without changing your other apps.
notifications.nativeOffHint: Turn push on here to receive alerts from the app on this phone.
notifications.nativePermissionCheckingHint: The app is checking whether iPhone Settings currently allows notifications. It will not claim delivery until that check succeeds.
notifications.nativeCleanupPendingHint: Push is off locally. The app is safely finishing removal of the previous device binding before it can turn on again.
notifications.loadError: Couldn’t check notification status. Your current setting was not changed.
notifications.toastBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Turn them on in your phone settings, then try again.
notifications.toastUnconfigured: Push isn’t set up on the server yet.
notifications.toastUnsupported: This device can’t receive push notifications.
notifications.toastGenericOn: Could not turn on push — please try again.
notifications.toastTurnedOff: Push turned off on this device
notifications.toastCleanupPending: Finishing the previous notification cleanup. Please try again in a moment.
notifications.toastOffCleanupPending: Push is off on this phone. Secure cleanup will retry automatically.
notifications.toastGenericOff: Could not fully turn off push — please try again.
notifications.hintRollout: Push is still rolling out and isn’t on for your account yet.
notifications.iosGuide: To get push on your iPhone, add this app to your Home Screen first: tap Share → Add to Home Screen, then open it from the Home Screen and turn push on here.
notifications.cantReceive: This device can’t receive push notifications.
notifications.serverNotSet: Push isn’t set up on the server yet — check back soon.
notifications.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked for this app. Turn them back on in your phone settings, then reopen the app.
notifications.quietTimeSub: Pause UPR notifications every day from 5:30 PM until 8:00 AM.
notifications.quietTimeStatusOn: On — notifications pause from 5:30 PM to 8:00 AM.
notifications.quietTimeStatusOff: Off — notifications can arrive at any time.
notifications.quietTimeLoadError: Couldn’t check quiet time. Your current setting was not changed.
notifications.quietTimeSaveError: Couldn’t update quiet time — please try again.
notifications.prefsSub: Pick how you want to hear about each one.
notifications.prefsEmpty: No notifications are turned on for your role yet.
